label: question
file: none

The weekly email is built from the template "email.rollup.line" ("{currency}: {count} transactions, {inflow} in, {outflow} out"). That template groups by currency, not by report or account, so the EUR figure likely counts every EUR transaction across all of your accounts for the week, while the "Operating account" report lists only that one account. I could not find the code that builds the rollup query in this run, so I have not confirmed which accounts or date boundaries it uses. The maintainers should confirm that before you give your CFO an explanation.
